sloka: इष्टिम् तेऽहम् करिष्यामि पुत्रीयाम् पुत्र कारणात् ।अथर्व सिरसि प्रोक्तैः मन्त्रैः सिद्धाम् विधानतः ॥१-१५-२॥
transliteration: iṣṭim te'ham kariṣyāmi putrīyām putra kāraṇāt ।atharva sirasi proktaiḥ mantraiḥ siddhām vidhānataḥ ॥1-15-2॥

translations.english: "I shall perform putriyeshti to help you beget sons. This is to be done in accordance with tradition for fulfilment of desires through mantras as declared in a portion of the Vedas, 'atharva siras'" .
